notes: Unique. Curly apostrophe in the slip's heading and caption (We’ll); wiki page title uses a straight one. Printed base is a Used Interrupt; slip banner reads USED OR LOST INTERRUPT. USED:/LOST: lines separated by \n. The slip prints the ▼ triangle after 'USED:' where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. 'Falcon' is italic on the slip both times (Han, Chewie, And The _Falcon_). Lore corrected from scan: the two quotes are in curly DOUBLE quotes (“I promise.” “Auuuuuug!”), wiki has straight single quotes; the number of u's in 'Auuuuuug' cannot be verified at 350 px (scan and VB2 remake both low-res) — wiki's six u's kept. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 (Cloud City) not legible. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px).
